typeHint.IPC: Monthly change of the national CPI, in percent. The system fetches it from INDEC and, while INDEC has not updated its file, from BCRA with one decimal.
typeHint.ICL: BCRA rental contract index, one value per day. Fetched by the system.
typeHint.UVA: BCRA purchasing value unit, one value per day. Fetched by the system.
typeHint.CVS: Monthly change of the wage variation coefficient (CVS), in percent. Entered by hand.
typeHint.CER: Monthly change of CER, in percent, for Casa Propia contracts. Entered by hand.
